class_guess: Bell eats counter: BECv1 tm10 with E1 = 1LB (3-cell binary counter with fillers + unary marker; eats shift the counter)
summary: tm10 sibling: 3-cell binary counter eats a unary run; 9 round rules predict 100% of rounds to 1e10
mechanism: Left: a binary counter in 3-cell blocks (1=100, 0=000, filler f=010 that carries skip). Right: tm10's 011 unary run with a 00 marker. Each round adds 1 and moves the marker one block left.
When the marker reaches the counter, one of 3 eats fires. EAT0f drops the low digit and fillers into the unary. EAT0z and EAT1 absorb the marker and shift the counter one cell right (phi).
The shifted blocks are debris (s=001). A carry that reaches an s re-encodes them (CARRY_S, recursive). On the blank run the debris is always gone before the next eat.

rules.name: CARRY
rules.cases: inc = binary +1 from the right: f skip, 1->0, 0->1 stop, overflow prepends 1

rules.name: CARRY_S (carry meets debris)
rules.cases: Y in {1,f}*, Y0 = Y with 1->0; incC = +1 with f=1, 0=0, s skipped (overflow prepends f); recursive when inc meets another s

rules.name: BIRTH (marker reborn at the right end)
rules.cases: NM(W,b,n) = 0^inf W b <E 11 (011)^n 0^inf; BIRTHC: NM(W,1,n+1) -> RS(inc W,0,n,1) (validated, never fires from blank)

rules.name: EAT0f
rules.cases: k >= 1, d in {0,1}, j >= 0; marker stays at the counter

rules.name: EAT0z
rules.cases: phi: 1->f, 0->0, f->s (each block shifted one cell right); W = 1^j uses W' empty

template.module: tm10 / nonhalt10, cert Build_BEC_cert_v1 B A E A [0] [1] [1] [0] [1] ... 1 0 0
template.diff: E1: 1LB (ours) vs 1LE (tm10); the other 11 transitions are equal (#7 has E1 = 0LA)
template.note:
Our TM on tm10's cert: 10/11 hypotheses hold (HL1, HL3-5, HR1-3, HE0-3: 25/25 each); HL2, the 1-cell carry 1<E1 -> <E11, fails 0/25 (E1 = 1LB sends the carry through B and C, so digits are 3 cells apart).
The unary half carries over; LeftBinaryCounter becomes a block-list counter with fillers and a phase-shifted debris region, closest to BECv7.v's inductive RIncs carry relation over 110/000/100 blocks.

strategy:
Proof on round starts RS/NM, with W over {1,0,f,s}. Invariant: no 1 left of an s, and no s at an eat (the flush lemma). Unary lemmas from BECv1; inc/incC/CARRY_S as an inductive carry relation in BECv7 style.
Then progress_nonhalt_cond. The open piece is the flush lemma: before the marker returns, the counter carries through every s block.
risks: The flush lemma is a size bound (2^(digits right of the leftmost s) < epoch length, about m+1); it holds with slack on the blank run (worst ratio 0.44, below 0.11 after 1e9) but is not proved.
An eat with s still present leaves the block alphabet; random words that do this can halt (26 of 1,200 fuzz samples), so the invariant must carry the bound.
CARRY_S is recursive (debris inside debris), so the Coq carry relation must be mutually inductive, like BECv7's RIncs.

checkpoint_questions.text: Fig 2: does each dark diagonal (the 00 marker) drift left until it meets the left band (the counter), and does a fresh diagonal then start further right?
Fig 3: once the head is back at the left, has the 00 gap gone, and is each counter 1-cell one cell further right than in the top row (plus one new 1 from the carry)?
